name: Bishop
overview: The title 'Bishop' in Scripture refers to the role of overseer within the church, entrusted by the Holy Spirit to shepherd and care for the flock, as seen in Acts 20:28. This leadership responsibility is closely connected with elders and pastors, who are appointed to guide the church through prayer and godly authority (Acts 14:23; Ephesians 4:11). Additionally, the term reflects the authority of Jesus Christ as the supreme Bishop, who exercises power and peace among His people (Matthew 9:6; John 20:19). Thus, the biblical concept of a bishop underscores both Christ’s sovereign lordship and the delegated pastoral oversight within the local church.
